- t: ወንሣእ ፡ እምንዋይከ ፡ መጠነ ፡ ትክል ፡ ዘፈቀድከ ፡ ወጒይይ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ብሔረ ፡ ባዕድ ፡ እስመ ፡ ቀታሌ ፡ ነቢያት ፡ ወኀሣሤ ፡ ደመ ፡ ንጹሓን ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ምናሴ ።
- i: and take of your goods as much as you can, whatever you have wished, and flee to a foreign land; for he is a killer of prophets and a seeker of the blood of the innocent (?) — Manasseh.'
